articles.title: RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
articles.summary: The real-world asset (RWA) protocol stUSDT is winding down its operations three years after reaching a peak of $2.3 billion in total value locked.

Total Value Locked (TVL) is the total amount of money that users have deposited into a crypto protocol. In this case, the protocol was a way for crypto users to earn returns on assets that track traditional bond values.

story.title: stUSDT Protocol Shutdown
story.so_far: Real-world asset (RWA) protocols on the blockchain allow users to earn yields on traditional financial assets like government bonds. timeline.text: The team announced the wind-down of the protocol, assuring users that all assets remain backed.
